newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa Stals says rand stable around 4.40 on dlr.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa Stals says rand stable around 4.40 on dlr.

text.p: South African Reserve Bank Governor Chris Stals said on Friday that the rand appeared relatively stable at around 4.40 to the dollar.
"It looks like it's fairly stable at this level of 4.40 now," he told parliament's finance committee.
Stals emphasised that the Reserve Bank, with limited foreign exchange reserves, could not dictate the exchange rate of the currency, but said he was reasonably happy with the present rate.
"If the markets are satisfied with the level of 4.40 and we can have a stable exchange rate there, at least for the rest of the year, we will be quite satisfied with that," he said.
